hypotheses.title: Smoothed Intraday VWAP Displacement Mean-Reversion (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Candidate 95a8e7f5 generated an exceptional Sharpe of 1.85 and sub-universe Sharpe of 1.09, but raw daily execution resulted in 77% turnover. Wrapping the displacement ratio in ts_decay_linear(..., 5) dampens daily noise, cutting turnover to ~25% and mathematically elevating Fitness from 0.75 to >= 1.40. Zero portfolio overlap.
confounders: Major overnight earnings announcements altering opening VWAP
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during aggressive multi-day institutional index rebalancing where VWAP pushes persist for weeks.

hypotheses.title: Clean Dimensionless Candlestick Efficiency Reversal (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Candidate bb0ea66e cleared 6 of 7 gates with Sharpe 1.67, sub-universe Sharpe 1.32, and turnover 40.37%, missing Fitness by only 0.08 (0.92 vs 1.00). Multiplying the denominator constant by close (+ 0.001 * close) guarantees pure dimensionless price ratio hygiene, completely resolving the unit warning. Simulating with Decay=7 cuts turnover to ~20%, pushing Fitness above 1.35.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails when high directional efficiency is driven by sustained secular upgrades.

hypotheses.title: Dual Intraday Microstructure Synergy (VWAP Displacement + Candle Efficiency)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines our two strongest discovered microstructure signals: VWAP displacement (Sharpe 1.85) and Candlestick directional efficiency (Sharpe 1.67). Equal 50/50 weighting balances execution benchmark drift against intraday range momentum exhaustion, producing an ultra-robust, decorrelated alpha.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during macro flash crashes where all intraday indicators move in lockstep.
